snippet: Not all breast tumors behave the same way, and part of the reason may be inherited rather than caused by the tumor itself. Using mice that carry the same cancer-causing HER2/neu gene but differ in genetic background, we found that introduction of the PWK/PhJ genetic background was associated with tumors that appeared about a month earlier.
